answer: Time-locked staking defeats forgery by freezing capital. Each identity locks 150 for 20 epochs, releasing 5% per honest epoch; fraud forfeits 60% and resets the clock. A meadow of idle clones cannot evade the lock: each fake needs its own frozen stake, and a mirror audit tends to expose clusters financed in one burst. 1,000 clones immobilize 150,000 units; 30% caught loses 27,000, and survivors stay frozen in the lagoon 10 more epochs.
